The Honeycomb Environments API provides administrative capabilities for managing environments within a Honeycomb team. Environments allow organizations to separate telemetry data across different stages such as development, staging, and production. The API supports listing, creating, updating, and deleting environments, along with the Auth API for validating API keys and determining their associated team and environment permissions. The Key Management API enables listing, creating, updating, and deleting API keys for a team.
